program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (frame-perimeter obj)
      (- (+ (* 2 (obj-h obj)) (* 2 (obj-w obj))) 4))
    (define (border-cell? obj p)
      (or (= (fst p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (fst p) (obj-r2 obj))
          (= (snd p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (snd p) (obj-c2 obj))))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 5)
           (> (obj-h obj) 1)
           (> (obj-w obj) 1)
           (= (obj-size obj) (frame-perimeter obj))
           (all? (lambda (p) (border-cell? obj p)) (obj-cells obj))))
    (define frames (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0)))
    (define (interior-cells frame)
      (positions-in-rect (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1) (- (obj-r2 frame) 1) (- (obj-c2 frame) 1)))
    (define (marker-values frame)
      (filter
        (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 5))))
        (map (lambda (p) (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p))) (interior-cells frame))))
    (define target
      (find-first (lambda (frame) (= (length (marker-values frame)) 1)) frames))
    (if (not target)
        g
        (let ((fill-color (first (marker-values target))))
          (grid-from-fn h w
            (lambda (r c)
              (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                (if (and (= v 0)
                         (> r (obj-r1 target)) (< r (obj-r2 target))
                         (> c (obj-c1 target)) (< c (obj-c2 target)))
                    fill-color
                    v))))))))
